description.zh:
代金券是否生效。取值范围：
- true
- false
description.en:
Specifies whether the voucher takes effect. Valid values:

*   true: The voucher takes effect.
*   false: The voucher does not take effect.

description.zh: 代金券终止过期时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
description.en: The end time of the validity period of the voucher. Specify the parameter in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. Example: 2018-08-01T00:00:00Z.

description.zh: 代金券起始过期时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
description.en: The start time of the validity period of the voucher. Specify the parameter in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. Example: 2018-08-01T00:00:00Z.
